system.summary: Numerical codes: 1796 small numbers (1-3 digits) with accent marks; 1797-1801 a larger list with prefixes and superscripts; neither matches the known 1789-92 or 1795-96 tables.

prior_solution.where: Colenbrander Gedenkstukken II-III searched in full text: not printed

conditions.human_role: Lead chosen by the user from the KHA sweep; user asked to transcribe the nine passages and test the reede1789 table and the Euler list.

solution.what: A35-1232 and A32-549 paired page by page (research/nationaal_archief/k89 pairing files): nine passages without decipherment.
Nine passages and four glossed control pages transcribed at full size (runs_a.txt, runs_b.txt).

reede1789 table and the 1795-96 Euler list tested on the 15 glossed control runs: R 3/13 own gloss vs 2/13 another; E 3/32 vs 0/32. Control values (91 Ivoy, 72 Duc, 13 Athlone, 6/52 Haugwitz) contradict both.
Colenbrander Gedenkstukken II and III full text: no Van Reede letter to the Erfprins printed.

outcome.method_basis: Neither known key of the correspondents fits the glossed controls; the codes of 1796 and 1797-1801 are not rebuildable from about 15 glossed values.

gaps.item: nine passages of A35-1232 and A32-549, about 580 groups
gaps.detail: neither the reede1789 table nor the Euler list fits; too few glosses to rebuild
